notes.title: "Impasse Journey": A Post-Apocalyptic Tale in Taiwan, Launching on Steam
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8336155/a80a3bee7f34c2291d4f1001749b806b3b5fdf93.png[/img]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2464330/_/]"Impasse Journey" Steam[/url][/b]

"Impasse Journey", This visual novel, set in a post-apocalyptic Taiwan, is poised for its debut on the Steam platform.

In "Impasse Journey", the storyline unfolds in the year 20XX, against the backdrop of a sudden Taiwan Strait conflict that plunged the world into an apocalyptic chaos. Fast forward 30 years, and Taiwan has morphed into a mosaic of self-governing regions, each striving to forge a new existence amidst the remnants of the old world.

Players will immerse themselves in the role of Yang Qiongqi, a reticent yet emotionally complex protagonist, on a quest to fulfill a promise and discover the truth. The journey begins in Kaohsiung, where players are thrust into a brewing conflict between local vigilantes and the government forces, with each decision shaping the narrative's course.

"Impasse Journey" is rich in narrative, offering over 300,000 words of engrossing storyline that delve into the background and motives of each character. Beyond Yang Qiongqi, players will encounter a diverse cast, including Huang Shihan, a young woman driven by ideals to join the vigilantes, Xiao Ziqin, a war-orphaned girl with impressive leadership skills, and Wu Yating, a dreamer from the underbelly of Kaohsiung.

The game stands out for its intricate depiction of post-war life in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, exploring themes of survival and rebirth. Through a multitude of choices, players will navigate a narrative intertwined with the daily struggles and overarching storyline of a world rebuilt from ruins.

"Impasse Journey" is set to offer a unique gaming experience, as players search for hope and meaning in a world that has known immense destruction. With its imminent release on Steam, the game promises a memorable foray into a world of survival and discovery.

notes.title: 1.1.0-1.2.0 Patch
notes.content:
[b]1.1.0[/b]
Fixed the problem that the title screen would flicker black when the title screen was closed for file reading and special recording.
Fixed the problem that LOG was not correctly positioned when the options were lower than three.
Fixed the problem that system settings could not be saved and read correctly.
Added a new UI entry to adjust the corresponding UI when switching between languages.
Removed the setting that lowers the volume of BGM when playing voice.

[b]1.2.0[/b]
Adjusted some of the English and Japanese interfaces
Fixed some text and performances.
Fixed the problem that the CG in the special collection could not be clicked.
Added a new screen when leaving the game.
Added confirmation option for window exit button.
